title: Protocol Metadata Record
description: Metadata-only record for a biological assay or laboratory operation protocol. This schema does not contain protocol instructions or source text.

title.description: Human-readable title of the protocol or source record.

protocolType.description: High-level format or publication type shown to users, such as wet-lab protocol, peer-reviewed protocol, or methods chapter.

assay.description: Named assay, experimental readout, or biological technique.

operation.description: Primary laboratory operation performed by the protocol.

source.description: Publisher, repository, organization, or database hosting the source record.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical URL for the source record or its stable discovery page.

published.description: Publication or first-release date in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated.description: Most recent source-record update date in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

license.description: Human-readable license or reuse statement as displayed or reported by the source.

confidence.description: Normalized confidence score used to rank records within a cluster, from 0 (lowest) to 1 (highest).

clusterId.description: Stable identifier for the assay or operation cluster used to group near-duplicate or equivalent records.

clusterSize.description: Number of records currently assigned to the cluster.

tags.description: Search and faceting terms for the record.

status.description: UI visibility or curation state for this record.

notes.description: Short curator note about scope, limitations, or source handling.

sourceRecordId.description: Stable identifier assigned by the source, such as a protocol ID, article ID, accession, or catalog key.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier in canonical DOI form, without an https://doi.org/ prefix.

authors.description: Ordered list of credited authors or contributors.

recordType.description: Machine-readable classification of the source record.

licenseCode.description: Normalized license identifier or reuse category. Prefer an SPDX or Creative Commons identifier when available.

licenseUrl.description: URL for the applicable license text or source reuse terms.

licenseVerifiedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the license code and reuse terms were last checked.

metadataVerifiedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the core metadata was last checked against the source record.

evidenceStatus.description: Evidence and review state for the record metadata; it does not certify experimental performance.

verificationStatus.description: Current metadata verification state used by the prototype UI.

evidenceLevel.description: Coarse evidence level used to explain the prototype ranking.

specimen.description: Sample or specimen material addressed by the protocol, such as cultured cells, tissue, or purified DNA.

organism.description: Organism, taxon, cell line, or biological system associated with the protocol.

platform.description: Required or supported instrument, sequencer, microscope, thermocycler, software, or other platform.

methodVariant.description: Short description of the protocol variant or distinguishing conditions used for clustering and filtering.

safetyLevel.description: Biosafety or risk-group label explicitly associated with the record; this is not a substitute for institutional review.

qcNotes.description: Curator notes on metadata quality checks, missing fields, duplicate resolution, or source inconsistencies.

name.description: Display name of the author or contributor.

orcid.description: ORCID URL when an author identifier is available.

affiliation.description: Affiliation associated with this author in the source record.

scoreBreakdown.description: Optional component scores supporting the aggregate confidence value.

sourceAuthority.description: Assessment of source authority and editorial quality.

recordSpecificity.description: Assessment of whether the source is a unique record rather than a collection or search page.

sourceQuality.description: Assessment of source authority and editorial quality.

evidenceStrength.description: Assessment of direct source evidence and review status.

metadataCompleteness.description: Fractional assessment of required metadata completeness.

recency.description: Assessment of how current the source record is.

licenseClarity.description: Assessment of how clearly reuse rights are stated.

clusterConsistency.description: Assessment of agreement with other records in the assigned cluster.

clusterAgreement.description: Legacy alias for cluster consistency in prototype records.

overall.description: Aggregate score copied into the metadata record for transparency.

method.description: Scoring method or model identifier used to calculate the aggregate confidence.

version.description: Version of the scoring rubric or model.
